test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the option with the correct use of future tense.

options.text: By next December, I will have been completed six years in this home.
By next December, I will be completed six years in this home.
By next December, I will have complete six years in this home.
By next December, I will have completed six years in this home.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct use of the future perfect tense is “will have completed.” This tense describes an action that will be finished by a certain point in the future.

Therefore, the correct phrase is "By next December, I will have completed six years in this home."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "By next December, I will have been completed six years in this home."** – Incorrect use of tense; "will have been completed" is wrong.
 
• **Option 2: "By next December, I will be completed six years in this home."** – Incorrect use of tense; "will be completed" is wrong.
 
• **Option 3: "By next December, I will have complete six years in this home."** – Incorrect form; "complete" should be "completed."
